title: Course Re-Check Allowance for Visit Referral Lengthenings
content:
When an In-Group Specialist Referral, an HMO Specialist Referral, an Out-of-Network Referral or a Physical Therapy Episode Authorization (Referrals & Prior Authorizations) is lengthened, the course re-check allowance follows the age, on the handling date, of the last coverage verification on the patient's Patient Financial Account: older than both the type's coverage re-verification figure and the financial class's re-verification period gives the payer course re-check allowance of 5 days; older than the type's figure but within the class's re-verification period gives the internal course re-check allowance of 2 days; otherwise there is no allowance.

The anchored span of the course and the allowance are added together, all in calendar days, to give the course validity days counted before any course weekend roll; where there is no allowance, nothing is added to the anchored span.

## The type's coverage re-verification figure

| Referral type | Figure (days) |
|---|---|
| In-Group Specialist Referral | 90 |
| HMO Specialist Referral | 30 |
| Out-of-Network Referral | 30 |
| Physical Therapy Episode Authorization | 30 |

## Questions answered

**How is the age measured?** In calendar days from the coverage verification date on the Patient Financial Account to the handling date. "Older than" means greater than; an age equal to a figure is within it.

**An HMO Specialist Referral, verification 50 days old, class period 45 days?** Older than 30 and older than 45: 5 days.

**The same referral, class period 60 days?** Older than 30 but within 60: 2 days.

**An In-Group Specialist Referral, verification 50 days old?** Not older than 90: no allowance, whatever the class period.

**How does an allowance combine with the anchored span?** They are added together. For a hypothetical lengthening with an anchored span of 40 days and the payer course re-check allowance of 5 days, the course validity days before any course weekend roll are 45.
